title: ITIL 4 Managing Professional - ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver, and Support (CDS)
overview: This course focuses on the core service management activities required to create, deliver, and support IT services. It provides participants with the knowledge and skills necessary to ensure that services meet customer needs, are delivered efficiently, and are continuously improved.
audience: IT service managers and team leads
IT professionals involved in service delivery
IT consultants focused on service management and operations
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth exploration of service management.
Practical Labs: Hands-on activities for real-world service management.
Case Studies: Practical application of ITIL principles.
Assessments: Quizzes and mock exams to prepare for certification.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop a practical understanding of creating, delivering, and supporting services.
Learn how to optimize workflows and manage service performance.
Understand the role of incident and problem management in delivering effective IT services.
Prepare participants for the ITIL CDS certification exam.

items.text: Creating and Managing Service Value Streams
Monitoring and Reporting on Service Performance
Problem Identification and Root Cause Analysis
Leveraging AI and Machine Learning in Service Management
